status_summary: An Attorney General memorandum dated 2025-02-05 directed DOJ to prioritize the elimination of cartels and transnational criminal organizations. It suspended certain internal approval requirements for racketeering charges against them, with 24-hour notice to the Criminal Division, for an initial 90 days that could be renewed or made permanent, and it expanded two task forces, JTF Vulcan and JTF Alpha. A separate 2025-02-05 charging memorandum directed prosecutors to charge the most serious readily provable offense. A later Deputy Attorney General memorandum of 2025-09-24 elevated and expanded JTF Alpha to target human smuggling and trafficking by cartels and other transnational criminal organizations and set priorities for prosecuting offenses involving unaccompanied alien children. The sources reviewed do not show a policy of prosecuting simple possession of distributable quantities.

timeline.event: An executive order directed the designation of certain cartels and other organizations as foreign terrorist organizations and specially designated global terrorists.
